blockingIssues.description: `validateReplayRange` still only validates the selected `scene.paintRecords[range]` slice and ignores scoped-layer depth that was already open before `range.lowerBound` or remains open after `range.upperBound`. Marker-free interior subranges can therefore replay without their required enclosing scoped-layer markers. This keeps `scene-replay-range-safety` red and also leaves the bundled replay code reviewed under `scene-family-ordering-and-batching` unsafe.

`GPUISceneBridge` still documents unsupported-style fallbacks that disagree with the implemented and tested behavior: `.path` clips are described as bounding-rect fallback even though the code/tests treat them as a full-surface no-op, and radial/conic gradients are described as using the gradient start color even though the code/tests preserve `cmd.color`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For scrutiny-driven reruns, add an explicit step to reproduce each previously reported blocking finding with a targeted adversarial test or direct probe before declaring success.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The rerun for `scene-replay-range-safety` passed the existing GPUIScene/full test/build flow and handed off success without adding a targeted interior-subrange regression, leaving the exact previously reported scoped-layer replay bug reproducible in the current branch.
